phase_name: Suite scaffold, dirty-repo fixture, and baseline green cases

objectives.description: Create test-guard-destructive-git.sh scaffold with pass/fail/info helpers, mktemp workdir, trap cleanup
Resolve hook path relative to SCRIPT_DIR (works in both source-store and deployed modes)
Implement case runner asserting on exit code only
Fixture self-check meta-case + clean-tree/empty-command exemption meta-cases
Baseline green cases: over-staging true positives, single-line exemption, one true positive per destructive detector
chmod +x, run against unmodified hook, confirm all green

approaches_tried.description: Constructed detector-3-7 message-text false-positive cases as ordinary prose (e.g. 'revert the git reset --hard fallout') without a preceding separator character
approaches_tried.reason: These detectors anchor extraction/match on (^|[;&|][[:space:]]*) -- start-of-string or a literal ;/&/| character -- so a destructive phrase preceded only by ordinary prose (e.g. "the ") never reaches the match, even pre-fix. Reproduced empirically: all such cases were GREEN against the unmodified hook, so per plan Phase 2 instructions they were replaced with semicolon-punctuated message text before being counted as evidence.
